appearances.snippet: I was then given a Dropbox link containing research, polling data, internal comments and strategy material compiled by VFT and the third party involved. ... Inside the Dropbox were seven folders.

verification.notes: Cuccia publicly described receiving a Dropbox with seven folders and summarized its contents; multiple reports reproduce the account. The full Dropbox and provenance have not been independently authenticated.
